name: PARALLEL LOST
source:
The main character just got into college and is going to high school.
Crossing the big mountain of university, this time an exponentially large mountain was blocking his life.
He moved to Parallel World, where he did not exist.
In this time and time that our existence has disappeared,
Will the main character be able to go back to his original world?
